title: FDCPA - covered debt and collectors
facts: The federal Fair Debt Collection Practices Act primarily regulates debt collectors collecting consumer debts incurred for personal, family or household purposes.
The FDCPA generally does not cover business debts.
Original creditors collecting their own debts are often outside the FDCPA definition of debt collector, though other federal or state laws may still apply.
Mortgage, medical, credit-card and other consumer debts can fall within the FDCPA when collection is performed by a covered debt collector.
